chunks: Wahb ibn Abd Rabbih narrated from him:

Regarding a man who had with him an umm walad of his, and she entered ihram before her master: is it permissible for him to nullify her ihram and have intercourse with her before he himself enters ihram? He said: "Yes."

key_terms.أُمُّ وَلَدٍ: a slave-concubine who has borne a child to her master
key_terms.فَأَحْرَمَتْ: she entered the state of ihram for hajj or 'umrah
key_terms.يُحْرِمَ: to enter the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: Can a master nullify the ihram of his umm walad and have intercourse with her before entering ihram himself?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning an umm walad who enters ihram before her master. It indicates that before the master himself enters ihram, he may nullify her ihram and have intercourse with her.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2568 - Wahb ibn Abd Rabbih narrated from Imam (as)

regarding a man whose concubine entered the state of Ihram before her master.
He asked: "Is it permissible for him to nullify her Ihram and have intercourse with her before entering Ihram himself?"
Imam (as) replied: "Yes."
